subject: Control System
questionText:
A unity feedback system has open loop poles at s = –
2  j2, s = –1, and s = 0; and a zero at s = – 3. The
angle made by the root locus asymptotes with the
real axis and the point of Intersection of the
asymptotes are
(a)
(60°, –60°, 180°) and –3/2
(b)
(60°, –60°, 180°) and –2/3
(c)
(45°, –45°, 180°) and –2/3
(d)
(45°, –45°, 180°) and –4/3
MCQ 
     EASY
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-13 (Root Locus-(Part-01&02)).
